text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early morning after the break. Admire Vega 
started her voluntary training, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I really can't focus, after all. 
...Seriously, why did I... do something 
like that, like that—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Staying up late just to buy a pair of 
slippers...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Admire Vega is suffering 
from a lack of sleep...
